config_name: MacBook Pro 14-inch — M5 Pro 15-core CPU / 16-core GPU, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard, Touch ID, Force Touch trackpad

battery.notes: Up to 22h video / 14h web claimed; 72.4Wh. NBC found the M5 Pro 16-inch's runtime a bit shorter than M4 Pro's.

price.notes: Verified on apple.com/ca buy page (see research/parts/apple/NOTES.md).

offers.name: Apple MacBook Pro 14.2" (2026) - Space Black (Apple M5 Pro / 24GB RAM / 1TB SSD) - English

reviews.quote: The new Apple M5 Pro SoC is a perfect fit... it can utilize the full performance of the chip without throttling. We see noticeable performance advantages over the previous M4 Pro chip (~20 % CPU, 30-50 % GPU) (same chip tested in the 16-inch chassis)
exceptional battery life... lasts well over a full day; exceptional build quality... all-aluminum unibody (same chassis, M5 model tested)

praises: M5 Pro delivers ~20% CPU and 30-50% GPU gains over M4 Pro — big jump for video exporters (NBC benchmarks)
Thunderbolt 5 (vs TB4 on the M6 tier) for fast docking and external storage (NBC)
PCIe 5.0 SSDs are much faster than the previous generation (NBC)
Mini-LED XDR 120Hz panel with optional matte remains best-in-class (NBC)
Stays very quiet in most scenarios even with the hotter Pro chip (NBC)
complaints: Prices are still high, especially when you add upgrades (NBC con)
Still no SD Express support in the card reader (NBC con)
Wi-Fi 7 module only supports 160 MHz, capping transfer rates around 2 Gbps (NBC)
RAM and SSD soldered; 24GB base but +$300 per tier to 48/64GB
Same 5-year-old chassis; a redesign is overdue (NBC and Tom's Hardware)

design_philosophy: The M5 Pro tier is the classic MacBook Pro sweet spot: a higher-core-count chip with Thunderbolt 5 and a wider GPU bus in the same compact pro chassis. This 15-core/16-core GPU build targets editors and developers who want real multicore throughput at 1.6 kg.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's 92.3% review of the M5 Pro in the 16-inch chassis (no 14-inch M5 Pro review found): −0.5 thermals_noise and −0.5 battery for the smaller chassis/72.4Wh vs 100Wh; TB5 ports raise port_connectivity +1 vs M6 tier. Chassis anchored by RTINGS 8.4 / NBC 90.9% on the 2025 14-inch. Sentiment synthesized from pro reviews — Reddit API blocked (403).
